question: Which INF section name should the driver index store for a Net class device?
allowedInputs: dll/win32/netcfgx/installer.c reads Characteristics from the section name stored by the driver index
source/build-amd64/drivers/network/dd/rtl8139/netrtl.inf puts Characteristics in RTL8139_Inst.ndi and points at that section from RealtekMfg
Reported: the live CD log said Characteristics was missing from section RealtekMfg of netrtl.inf, so the Realtek adapter was not installed
